text:
nina: ok this is peak WFH parenting. my kid swapped my webcam for a stuffed penguin mid-standup. he was very proud. pictures attached. 
rob: hahahahaha brilliant. did he also change your background to the fridge? :joy: 
carmen: quick fix: tilt your laptop down and use phone as hotspot + camera in a pinch. or flip to audio-only till you can domesticate the penguin.
yusuf: tip: cheap clamp mount from amazon for $12. clamps to the monitor and keeps little hands from redecorating your camera. also black duct tape works in desperate situations.
nina: tried tape first, penguin refused to be silenced. also had to explain to boss that the penguin has thoughts on the roadmap.
rob: emoji reaction: :penguin: :laughing: 
carmen: if you want a fancy one-liner: "apologies, my product manager (age 3) updated the priorities."
ops-bot: reminder: if background blur or virtual backgrounds are needed for meetings, our help doc has quick steps for Zoom/Meet: https://company.help/wfh-video-setup
yusuf: also pro move: keep a "meeting bag" with a spare webcam, headphones, and a mug. store in closet or high shelf. saved me from toddler-ambush twice.
nina: adding "meeting bag" to my checklist. also labeling everything with a sharpie so my toddler can't claim my headset as theirs.
rob: gif: tiny penguin pointing at a whiteboard :laughing: 
carmen: someone should make a sticker: "Ask me about my penguin PM"
nina: can confirm penguin will be invited to next retro. :raised_hands: 
rob: pro-tip for folks with curious pets/kids: put a cheap stuffed toy on the shelf as a decoy. they take it and leave your gear alone 50% of the time. results may vary. 
ops-bot: note: IT can ship a temporary webcam to your home if needed for >3 days outage. ping @it-support in #help with your address.
yusuf: also this thread made my morning. thanks for the laugh :)
